slides.title: Why your photos came out looking like someone else.
slides.body: It's almost never the AI. It's the *four photos* you gave it.

slides.title: The AI doesn't invent your face.
slides.body: It works from the one you give it. Three blurry photos from 2019 and you'll get a stranger who *resembles* you. That's not a glitch — it's the input.

slides.title: Upload these four
items: One full-body photo, head to feet
One waist-up on a plain background
One where you're genuinely smiling, teeth showing

slides.title: Why the smiling one matters.
slides.body: Without it, every smile has to be invented. With it, your *real* smile carries into every shot — the shape of it, how your eyes move.

slides.title: What ruins it
items: Heavy filters — the AI learns the filter, not you
Sunglasses or anything covering your face
Group photos, where it can't tell which face is yours

slides.title: Four good photos. That's the whole secret.
